title: Pump order: 11-message thread with a price change, a split delivery, a late finance approval and our acceptance

task.goal: Buy 250 SP-220 solenoid pumps (rev C) for PO-3390. All 250 must arrive by Fri Dec 11; unit price must not exceed $48.00.

Ingrid,

We need 250 SP-220 solenoid pumps (rev C, 24VDC) on PO-3390, all delivered to our Dayton plant by Fri Dec 11. Please quote unit price, delivery and terms.

E

notes: Long thread mixing four kinds of change: price from/to (m6), a split delivery that replaces the single-lot date (m8, partial in shape: 150 + 100), a finance approval that only arrives after an out-of-office (m4 is noise; budget_approval is unknown until m9), and our own acceptance in m10, which makes decision.order 'accepted' and hands the next move to the supplier. m5 is an engineering note with no authority ('I think Pemberton can do these by end of Nov' states no term). Old $46.50 and 'all 250 by Dec 4' persist in every quote. Distractors: ECN 26-114, ext 4410, budget line 7700-12, phone, $11,625 / $11,812.50 extended. PF-1187 is superseded by PF-1187-R1 (same kind, same party).
